title: Morning Brief — Sunday, 20 September 2026
description: Today: a US-funded search off Broome wraps up as the Junior Matildas qualify for the U-17 World Cup; Brisbane and Moreton detectives charge two men over 81 property offences and a Southport teen faces a Wavell Heights burglary charge; and HOTA welcomes the White Rabbit Collection and a new Children's Gallery exhibition to the Gold Coast. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made to listen to on the morning drive.
